title: Turn on the WhatsApp agent
summary: The agent confirms appointments and replies to patients over WhatsApp. It's turned on here; the Invoke team connects the number.

steps.title: Turn on the agent
steps.details: On: the agent replies to patients, confirms and reschedules appointments. Off: messages are left for the team to handle.
steps.description: With the agent on, it replies to patients and confirms appointments by itself.

steps.title: Agent office hours
steps.details: If you turn it on, outside office hours the agent replies with the message you set up instead of handling it.
steps.description: Optional: limit the hours the agent replies and what it says after hours.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.details: Saves the agent's settings. Changes apply to new messages.
